text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out with Fenomeno, as we were about 
to head to our next destination—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Found you guys, Mame-chin♪ Time for a 
quick and easy catch♡

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's pitch black!? Is that voice 
Golshi-san!? What is the meaning of this! 
Let go of me, hey--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I removed the blindfold, I was in an 
unfamiliar room. It seems I've been 
captured along with Fenomeno.
choice_data_list: Where... am I?
Where... am I?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea... There are no windows 
either, sir. It appears we have been 
locked inside a sealed room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Just then, the monitor in the room 
sprang to life with footage.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, welcome, you two. Shall we begin 
our escape game of betrayal?
choice_data_list: What did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple. Just solve the 
riddles set up in the room and make your 
escape.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Watch yourself, though. After all, this is 
"betrayal" we're talking about...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Are those two at it again...! Pulling such 
foolish pranks.
choice_data_list:
Anyway, escaping has to be our top 
priority right now.

Anyway, getting out of here is our top 
priority right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after saying that, I spot a 
smartphone lying on the ground. Could this 
be an item needed to escape?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The screen says "Press here", but... 
Suspicious. Knowing those two, they must 
be up to something!
choice_data_list:
Still, it's our only way out. Let's press 
it!

Still, it's our only way out. Let's press 
it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Boss! Maybe you should think it over a 
bit more...!

text_block_list.name: Golshi's Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Buy some 2-in-1 conditioning body wash on 
your way back, by the lot. Counting on 
ya."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Is this... just a voice recording asking 
us to run an errand?
choice_data_list: Wait, it's not a riddle!?
Wait, it's not a riddle!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I was a fool to be on guard. Let's 
break right through them...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next, I spotted some writing on the wall. 
"Look to the right"... This looks 
suspicious. This has got to be part of the 
puzzle this time.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What's on the right... "Look up", it says.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Look left." "Look down."—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Look, there's a monitor beneath our feet! 
Whatever could it be showing...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Spinning your neck a full 360 
degrees was great exercise, right?
choice_data_list: Gymnastics!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheheh. I see, I was indeed 
betrayed. There isn't a single mystery 
here, is there?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Honestly! I refuse to indulge such 
tomfoolery...!
choice_data_list: Let's not worry about it and head outside!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I turn the doorknob, it opens with 
absolute ease. There was no mystery from 
the very start... It's outside—now I can 
escape.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wait, GYAAAAAAAH!?
choice_data_list: A pitfall!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
D-O-N-'T M-E-S-S W-I-T-H M-E-E-E!! I've 
reached my absolute limit!!!!
choice_data_list:
Looks like... I'll have to punish you 
thoroughly.

Looks like... I'll have to punish you 
thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Let's make them pay for toying with us!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, pure gold! I wish I could've seen 
the moment they fell up close!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Kuh, hand it over, quickly! Consider 
yourself apprehended~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I dropped a rope down, didn't I? Use 
it to climb up—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Hey, there's no rope?! Don't tell me...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"That voice is a decoy! SEEEECUUUUURE 
HEEERRRR!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We lured Gold Ship and the others out 
using the recorded voice and captured them 
from behind with ropes. It was a makeshift 
plan, but it worked.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Escaped while we were moving, huh? Even 
used tools... Damn it, we messed up.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
How do you like my capture technique? It's 
tied tight, so there's no escaping!
choice_data_list: Now, where do we go from here?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That's obviously— RE! FLEC! TION! TIME!!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, what a hectic day that was!

Ahaha, it really was quite a day, wasn't 
it?
Did I overdo it a bit?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That's obviously— RE! FLEC! TION! TIME!!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, what a hectic day that was!

Ahaha, it really was quite a day, wasn't 
it?
Did I overdo it a bit?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, the greater the effort, the 
greater the reward. Thanks to that, I was 
able to punish the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
They'll probably keep quiet for a while. 
Ah, what a truly refreshing feeling!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Thank you so much for your help with 
the capture!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's still not enough! You have no 
idea how much bitterness I've had to 
swallow...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I shall respect the Boss's 
leniency. I will let you off the hook in 
one hour, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: Come undone already~~~!! Tch.
